description: This file contains TypeScript code defining types, constants, utility functions, and API calls related to ClawHub packages and skills, including fetching details, searching, downloading archives, and version compatibility checks.

classes.name: ClawHubRequestError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling errors during ClawHub API requests, including status code and response body.

methods.name: resolveClawHubBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and resolves the base URL for ClawHub API requests, considering environment variables.

methods.name: formatSha256Integrity
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 integrity string in base64 format for given bytes.

methods.name: parseClawHubPluginSpec
methods.description: Parses a raw string to extract plugin specification details such as name, version, and base URL.

methods.name: fetchClawHubPackageDetail
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific ClawHub package by name.

methods.name: fetchClawHubPackageVersion
methods.description: Fetches specific version details of a ClawHub package.

methods.name: searchClawHubPackages
methods.description: Searches for packages on ClawHub based on a query and optional filters.

methods.name: searchClawHubSkills
methods.description: Searches for skills on ClawHub based on a query.

methods.name: fetchClawHubSkillDetail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific skill by slug.

methods.name: listClawHubSkills
methods.description: Lists available skills on ClawHub with optional limit.

methods.name: downloadClawHubPackageArchive
methods.description: Downloads a package archive from ClawHub, saves it temporarily, and returns its path and integrity.

methods.name: downloadClawHubSkillArchive
methods.description: Downloads a skill archive from ClawHub, saves it temporarily, and returns its path and integrity.

methods.name: resolveLatestVersionFromPackage
methods.description: Determines the latest version string from package details.

methods.name: isClawHubFamilySkill
methods.description: Checks if a package or skill detail belongs to the 'skill' family.

methods.name: satisfiesPluginApiRange
methods.description: Checks if a plugin API version satisfies a specified range.

methods.name: satisfiesGatewayMinimum
methods.description: Checks if the current version meets the minimum gateway version requirement.
